items.title: Anne Phillips interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, February 24, 2025
items.q: the people that I had known doing demos ... David Nadien, who was the concertmaster for Bernstein. That happened while doing it

ctx.x: Oh that’s good advice. Yeah. Was there contractors involved in this that you needed to deal with?

Yeah. Some of them, but pretty much like my first husband and I were in business together at that time and we really knew, I mean for instance the strings, the people that I had known doing demos — not demos but a lot of record dates, David Nadien, who was the concertmaster for Bernstein. That happened while doing it — but you know sometimes I’d ask them to put the string section together. And the horn players I knew actually from the rock-feeling things. There were piano players, mainly ones that worked on demos…
